def fn(x):
    plain  = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    trans = {}
    for p, c in zip(plain, cipher):
        trans[p] = c
        trans[p.upper()] = c.upper()
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)
```

def fn(x):
    plain  = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    trans = {}
    for p, c in zip(plain, cipher):
        trans[p] = c
        trans[p.upper()] = c.upper()
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)
